item.title: The Level 999 Villager Anime Casts Yuichiro Umehara as Menou: Release Date, Plot, and Cast Details
item.description: The upcoming Summer 2026 fantasy anime The Level 999 Villager has officially cast veteran voice actor Yuichiro Umehara to play Menou, a high-ranking demon noble.
